title: Cacophony
summary: CACOPHONY, noun 1. In rhetoric, an uncouth or disagreeable sound of words, proceeding from the meeting of harsh letters or syllables. 2. In medicine, a depraved voice; an altered state of the voice. 3

inlines.v: CACOPHONY, noun 1. In rhetoric, an uncouth or disagreeable sound of words, proceeding from the meeting of harsh letters or syllables. 2. In medicine, a depraved voice; an altered state of the voice. 3. In music, a combination of discordant sounds.
